name: hyper_turbo_approx
source: [AS] Per-turbo approximation, not a measured Koenigsegg map. 2026-10-03: effective turbine throat 500 mm2 enables steady 3000 rpm boost; reference head 4.5 bar, compressor/turbine efficiency 0.80. Smaller throat trades low-speed boost for higher high-speed exhaust pressure. Inertia, flow limit, reference speed and loss unchanged.
